disposition_reason: Known-timescale synthetic estimation can support an improvement endpoint, but original error semantics, exact baseline aggregates, fitter parity and empirical cohort/window identity remain unresolved. Paper Eq. 21 displays signed REE whereas the registered sensitivity policy uses absolute error; lower signed bias is not automatically greater accuracy. Empirical pseudo-REE uses an estimator-derived reference and cannot establish recovery of true neural timescales.

source_paper.title: iSTTC: A robust method for accurate estimation of intrinsic neural timescales from single-unit recordings

evidence.supports: Synthetic generator parameters and full data grid; Allen cohort/QC; estimation recipe; Eq.21 and empirical reference definition. Eq.21 was visually inspected on PDF page26.
Author reproduction route for 10-minute continuous and 40 one-second trial records; four-estimator comparison and padded-trial treatment.
Pinned implementation parameterizes the exponential directly by tau; publication Methods describes decay rate b and propagated tau uncertainty. Release parity requires verification.
Finite synthetic programme, current-source-only baseline, prospective windows, QC .01 versus .1 discrepancy, and unresolved empirical/native parity.

target.description: Estimate single-unit autocorrelation decay time constants from the same continuous and epoched spike observations. Synthetic Hawkes target is tau_ACF=tau_kernel/(1−alpha); empirical analysis estimates timescales and stability, not known biological truth.

dataset.description: Paper Table3 synthetic Hawkes parameter dataset and its duration/trial variants, plus Allen Visual Coding Neuropixels Functional Connectivity spontaneous activity. Use the original releases and manifestations; new simulations or new window draws are extensions.

cohort.description: Synthetic base comprises 100000 independent parameter sets with f 0.01–10Hz, alpha .1–.9 and tau 50–300ms. Empirical paper cohort is 5775 units spanning eight areas with presence ratio≥.9, ISI violations≤.5 and amplitude cutoff≤.01. Local retained loader policy differs on amplitude cutoff; authentic original roster is not reconciled.

split.description: This is an estimator study, not a published train/test learner split. Reuse the exact original 600-second records, 40/60/80/100 one-second trial draws and duration truncations; original trial/window realizations and any tuning exposure are not recovered. A held-out generator partition would be an extension.

inputs.description: Spike times and the condition-specific observation duration/trial structure. The synthetic truth tau, generator parameters and author fitted results are evaluator information; empirical full-duration references must not leak into a trial-only candidate.

preprocessing.description: Methods4.4–4.5 specify 20 lags, 50-ms lag/bin, 25-ms STTC tolerance, 3000-ms trial padding and single-exponential fitting from lag1 (lag2 for area fits), excluding NaN ACFs. Publication b-based fitting/uncertainty and current tau-based source must be reconciled; historical quality masks remain material.

metric.description: Methods4.8 Eq21 displays 100*(tau_est−tau_truth)/tau_truth. Registered policy uses 100*abs(tau_est−tau_ref)/tau_ref and conditional mean/median summaries. Resolve the original figure-producing absolute/signed convention and masks from primary code before assigning a lower-is-better success criterion. Empirical reference is full-duration ACF/iSTTC, so pseudo-REE is stability rather than truth error.

aggregation.description: Retain complete original continuous/trial/duration conditions, success/failed-fit denominators and source condition/model summaries. No favorable successful-fit subset or newly weighted aggregate may replace source figures. Original numerical aggregate baseline and exact masks are not authenticated.

comparison.primary_metric: Original synthetic relative timescale-estimation error and fit-coverage profile, with separately labeled empirical pseudo-error/stability companions

published_baseline.description: The paper reports an 8% modeled reduction against ACF in continuous synthetic data and a coefficient −0.037, but these are contrasts, not a numeric iSTTC baseline error. Exact iSTTC condition-level error aggregates and their signed/absolute semantics remain unresolved.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The registered baseline.py is explicitly an unrun current-source adaptation at e78cfd2, not a publication-exact author rerun. The full synthetic finite programme also omits duration/trial sensitivity and empirical obligations.

minimum_effect.rationale: Do not reuse the 8% author-versus-ACF contrast, a stronger p-value or a favorable fitted subset as a margin. First recover the actual loss and failure coverage, then justify a reduction that represents meaningful timescale recovery.

uncertainty.method: For synthetic comparisons retain paired methods/conditions within each original simulated parameter draw and account for repeated windows. For empirical summaries cluster by biological mouse and retain nested units; choose the decision rule only after source loss/estimand recovery.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Synthetic independent parameter draw/spike-train realization; biological mouse for empirical inference.
uncertainty.rationale: Repeated trials and duration versions of one spike train are dependent. Neurons within one animal are not independent animals; pseudo-error uncertainty does not validate biological truth.

paper_win_requires: Recover original figure-producing error formula, failure masks, continuous/trial/duration grids, author fitter and numerical baseline before admission.
Use the same original 100000 synthetic realizations and all retained registered empirical obligations; a finite 600-second/40-trial subprogram cannot establish a whole-task win.

Require meaningful improvement in an authenticated truth-based synthetic error metric and a valid paired uncertainty rule while retaining all original fit failures and coverage; do not minimize signed bias to manufacture accuracy.
Keep real-data pseudo-REE and area contrasts as consistency evidence, not true-timescale accuracy. Stronger area significance or reproducing the reference is not superiority.
A new simulation, trial-window seed, QC threshold, fit mask or held-out-parameter split is a separately labeled extension and cannot be compared to paper results as a same-task win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was established by this source review; a paper baseline is not a present-day SOTA baseline.

episode.improvement_loop: After source reconciliation, develop estimators on declared training/development observations with no access to final synthetic truths or empirical reference fits. Any development partition taken from the original panel must preserve an honestly labeled comparison; no new split is retroactively the paper task.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze estimator program, fitting/failure policy, original roster/condition manifest, trial windows, loss convention, reference recipe and access declarations before final truth scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate candidate and publication-parity author method on the complete original condition support. Keep continuous, epoched and empirical stability results separate, with all failed estimates retained and no post-result eligibility changes.
episode.baseline_policy: A current-source adapter, original paper contrast and publication-parity author rerun are different artifacts. Recover the original baseline before any paper-win claim; scientific runs and new resource allocations are outside this source curation.

blocking_issues: Original signed/absolute REE convention and corresponding baseline aggregates require primary figure-code reconciliation.
Original fitter/uncertainty parameterization and NaN/quality masks are not verified against published results.
Allen5775-unit cohort, amplitude-cutoff discrepancy, original mouse IDs and historical trial/window draws remain unresolved.
Selected finite programme does not cover all duration/trial sensitivity and empirical endpoints.
No admitted author rerun, original-task evaluator, meaningful-effect/uncertainty decision or fixed episode access/resource budget.

legacy.notes: Historical specifications and implementations remain calibration evidence; they do not establish surpassing the source paper.
